title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she prepares for the Japanese Derby, the second race of the Triple Crown tour, her eyes are on first prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But someone is already in the paddock receiving louder cheers than her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That someone is none other than Special Week, who is striving to become the best in Japan for her mothers.
